summary: Closed for a holiday? Tell me and I'll update every page.
content:
Your hours appear on the home page, the Contact page, the footer and the information search engines read. I keep them in one place, so one change updates them all.

## What to send me

Text me at (207) 555-0188 with:

- The dates that are changing
- Your hours on those days, or that you're closed
- Any short note for guests, such as "Closed for a private event"

## When to send it

Please send it **a week ahead** when you can. Anything sent before 3 p.m. on a weekday goes live that day.

Closing suddenly because of a storm or a power cut? Text me any time and I'll put a note on the site as soon as I can.

## Don't forget

Your hours also appear on Google and on OpenTable. I can't change those for you, so update them yourself. See [Accounts and renewals](ext/totalcms/client-help/post/accounts-and-renewals) for where they live.
title: Holiday hours and closures
author: Sam Keller
